option_relations.rationale: Lennox-Gastaut syndrome is a severe form of epilepsy, but it is not directly related to the specific genetic diagnosis presented in the vignette.
Epileptic encephalopathy, early infantile type is a broad category of severe epilepsies, but it is not the specific diagnosis indicated by the CHD2 gene variant.
Developmental and Epileptic Encephalopathy-94 (DEE-94) caused by pathogenic CHD2 gene variant is a specific diagnosis, but it is not equivalent to the provided leaf 'CDKL5 disorder'.
CHD2-related neurodevelopmental disorder (CHD2 encephalopathy) is the specific diagnosis indicated by the vignette, but it is not equivalent to the provided leaf 'CDKL5 disorder'.
